correctness.rationale: For even n=2m≥4, centered simplex edge vectors satisfy Σ_{i<j}v_ij v_ij*=P_{1⊥}, checked by expanding centered vertex p_i. Matching swap involution R_M gives E_M=(I+R_M−2J/n)/(n−2), hence [E_M,E_N]=(R_M R_N−R_N R_M)/(n−2)². On a doubled shared edge k=1 or alternating 2k-cycle, W=R_M R_N has each k-th root twice, producing two eigenvalues 2i sin(2πj/k)/(n−2)² for each j, with one global zero removed on 1⊥. Thus zero iff all k≤2, sharp maximum 0 for n4, sqrt(3)/16 for n6, 2/(n−2)² for n≥8 iff a k divisible by four. For fixed base matching, pair reconnection counts give C_m=Σ_t m!/[(m−2t)!t!]; labelled alternating k-component count 2^(k−1)(k−1)! yields generating functions (1−2z)^(−1/2), and after excluding k divisible by 4 multiplies (1−16z^4)^(1/8), proving A_m formula. Edge-vectors partition into four positive joint-outcome effects with both marginals; joint measurement holds regardless of commutator. Independently exhaustively enumerated matchings n4/6/8/10 with commuting counts 3/7/25/81 and maximizing counts 0/0/48/240; finite checks corroborate exact all-n reasoning.
